purpose: Add eight attributed devotional poem excerpts for prayer, grace, trust, hope, and daily dependence on Christ.

defaults.author: Charles H. Gabriel
defaults.sourceTitle: The Slighted Stranger and Other Poems

entries.title: Oh, It Is Wonderful
entries.text:
I marvel that He would descend from His throne divine
To rescue a soul so rebellious and proud as mine;

entries.title: Clinging to Jesus
entries.text:
CLOSE to Thee, my blessed Savior,
Keep me walking day by day;
Let me feel Thy presence with me.
Be my refuge all the way.

entries.text:
We shall have a new name in that bright land.
When, thro' grace, before the great King we stand

entries.title: Growing Dearer Each Day
entries.text:
Some day face to face I shall see Him,
And oh, what a joy it will be
To know that His love, now so precious,
Will forever grow dearer to me.

entries.title: Abide with Me
entries.text:
When foes without, and foes within assail me.
And I am tossed upon a troubled sea,
When, in my weakness, hope and courage fail me,
In mercy, then, abide with me.
entries.slideText:
When foes without, and foes within assail me.
And I am tossed upon a troubled sea,
When, in my weakness, hope and courage fail me,
In mercy, then, abide with me.
entries.recommendedUse: A prayer stanza for seasons of weakness; this is Gabriel's poem, distinct from Henry Francis Lyte's hymn.

entries.title: An Evening Prayer
entries.text:
Yet, blessed Lord,
Once again I pray:
Love and forgive me. Amen.

entries.title: All in All to Me
entries.text:
All In all to me is Jesus,
Blessed One of Calvary;
I will never cease to love Him
Who has done so much for me.
